feedback.problem:
Describe the set $S={3,5,7,9,11,...}$ using a constructive definition.

$$
S={{{field-1}}\,:\,n\,{{field-2}}}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that the elements of our set

$$
3,\,5,\,7,\,11,\,…
$$

form an arithmetic sequence with common difference $d=2:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =2 \\  & =5-3 \\  & =7-5 \\  & =⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $n$th term ${a}_{n}$ of our sequence for $n\in N,n\ge 1$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)\cdot d \\  & =3+(n-1)\cdot 2 \\  & =3+2n-2 \\  & =2n+1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can define our set using a constructive definition as follows:

$$
S={2n+1\,:\,n\in N}
$$
